summary: Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) is public technical university in Eindhoven, Netherlands, founded in 1956. Type: public sector / education / research. About 3,000 employees (Wikidata). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 21 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding.

insights.one_liner: Technical university in Eindhoven with close ties to the region's high-tech firms; all 21 research jobs here are in English and show pay.

culture.text: All 21 openings are research and academic roles in Eindhoven.
Has close ties to the high-tech companies of the Eindhoven region.
Names Curious, Open, Respectful and Responsible as its guiding values.

open.text: None of its 21 jobs here require Dutch, and all of them show the salary.
The number of international students more than doubled in four years.
It is not listed in the IND recognised sponsor data we hold.

growth.text: Sends students abroad, for example to Tainan, Taiwan, to learn about semiconductors.

worth_knowing.text: Hosted a top semiconductor summer school for students from across the globe.
